subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Should maintainers keep this broad umbrella open, or split it into narrower follow-ups for systemd SecretRef deployment docs, update config-diff/safe-update behavior, and self-healing audit scope?
rationale: Current main already implements meaningful parts of the request, while the remaining parts cross docs, setup, update, auth, and audit product boundaries that should not be bundled into one automated fix.

options.title: Split into focused follow-ups
options.body: Create or designate narrow issues for the remaining docs, update-preview, and audit-scope work, then use this issue as the umbrella only until that split is done.

options.title: Keep as umbrella tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical cross-surface tracking item, accepting that implementation should still happen through separate PRs.

options.title: Close as sufficient
options.body: Treat current bind precedence, token guidance, dry-run, and audit surfaces as enough, and decline the remaining bundled product requests.

recommendation.title: Split into focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Create or designate narrow issues for the remaining docs, update-preview, and audit-scope work, then use this issue as the umbrella only until that split is done.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across update, docs, audit, and Crestodian surfaces touched by the remaining product decision.
